display.purpose: All h1-h4. Sentence case only; italic (never weight) carries emphasis, including the signature italic counter-clause.

label.purpose: Uppercase 12px section label in Dusty Blue-Grey, one line above its heading. The only uppercase voice.

motion.name: ease-editorial
motion.purpose: The only easing. Soft entrance, no overshoot.

motion.name: reveal-up
motion.value: 0.6s ease-editorial, opacity 0 + translateY(14px) to rest, stagger ~0.11s
motion.purpose: The single signature entrance animation; collapses to static under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button and link state changes (background, color).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Matte charcoal block on ivory; the loudest element on any screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-primary, #1c1c1c); color: var(--color-bg, #f4f1ec); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark, #2a2a2a); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action; inverts to charcoal on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1c); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-ink, #1c1c1c); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1c); color: var(--color-bg, #f4f1ec); }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Matte paper card: slight tonal lift, hairline border, strictly no shadow.
components.html:
Data hygiene

Your CRM has three fields nobody fills in, and one report everybody distrusts.
components.css: .ds-surface-card { background: var(--color-surface, #f8f6f1); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #ddd6cb); border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.5rem; max-width: 340px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1c); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #474747); margin: 0; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Uppercase Dusty Blue-Grey section label; the only uppercase voice in the system.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-eyebrow, #5a88b8); }

components.name: Underline Link
components.description: Prose link with the signature scale-in underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-link-underline { position: relative; color: var(--color-link, #5a88b8); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link-underline::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -2px; width: 100%; height: 1.5px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-link-underline:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

narrative.overview: Every surface in this funnel reads like a candid consultant's report printed on good paper. The ground is Warm Ivory, the ink is Deep Charcoal, and nothing shines: no shadows, no gradients, no glass. Authority comes from typography (an editorial serif for headlines, a plain humanist sans for everything else) and from restraint: color appears only where it carries meaning. The product is a diagnostic, and the design behaves like one: matte, precise, unhurried.
keyCharacteristics: No pure white, no pure black; the whole world lives between ivory (#f4f1ec) and charcoal (#1c1c1c).
Completely flat: zero drop shadows; depth is tonal (ivory, card, sand) plus hairline borders.
One radius (8px) everywhere; no pills, no sharp corners.
Serif display type in sentence case, with the italic counter-clause as the signature typographic move.
Two accents only, used sparingly: Muted Sage for warmth and affirmation, Dusty Blue-Grey for eyebrows and prose links.
One signature motion: a soft reveal-up on load; nothing bouncy, ever.

rules.name: The No Pure White Rule
rules.body: #ffffff and #000000 do not exist on screen. The lightest value is Card Ivory, the darkest is Deep Charcoal. The single exception is the print stylesheet, where the body goes white for paper.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: Sage affirms, Dusty Blue labels and links. Neither ever exceeds a small fraction of a screen, and neither is a text color for body copy.

rules.name: The Italic Counter-Clause Rule
rules.body: Two-part headlines set the counter-clause in italic. This is the brand's signature typographic move; new headlines should look for the opportunity.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headlines are sentence case. Never Title Case, never ALL CAPS (the 12px eyebrow is the sole uppercase voice).

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, ever, in any state. If an element needs separation, it gets a tonal fill or a hairline border, not a shadow.

rules.name: The One Reveal Rule
rules.body: One signature entrance: reveal-up over 0.6s with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), staggered ~0.11s. No bounce, no overshoot, no parallax. prefers-reduced-motion collapses everything to static.

dos: Do keep every background ivory-family and every text charcoal-family.
Do use italic (not weight) for emphasis in headlines.
Do use the eyebrow + serif headline pattern to open sections.
Do keep the report printable: test new report elements against the print stylesheet.
Do write microcopy in the brand voice: problem-first, plain, radically candid, dot-separated qualifiers ("Free · No pitch").
donts: Don't use drop shadows, gradients, glassmorphism, or pure white/black.
Don't use purple-indigo AI-default palettes or emoji clusters.
Don't use em or en dashes anywhere, including generated copy; restructure or use a single hyphen.
Don't introduce new accent colors, new radii, or bouncy animation.
Don't use the banned vocabulary: supercharge, unleash, game-changer, leverage, synergy, ecosystem, 10x.
